question: Area of the base of a right circular cone is 308 cm² and its height is 7√2 cm. Find its curved surface area (in cm²). (Use π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the base of a right circular cone (A) = 308 cm²

Height (h) = 7√2 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of the base (A) = πr²

Curved surface area (CSA) = πrl

Where,

r = radius of the base

l = slant height

l = √(r² + h²)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbfe20f3d7db925c5212af3caa9a781ebf98e6eb6ba6484160e181700ba487cb.png] 

πr² = 308

⇒ (22/7)r² = 308

⇒ r² = (308 × 7) / 22

⇒ r² = 98 ⇒ r = 7√2

Now, l = √(r² + h²)

⇒ l = √(98 + 98)

⇒ l = √196 ⇒ l = 14

Curved surface area (CSA) = πrl

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 7√2 × 14

⇒ CSA = 22 × 2 × √2

⇒ CSA = 308√2

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
